title: A project I am proud of
summary: Replace this with a project: the problem, what you did, and what changed because of it.

body.markdown: This is a sample case study. Keep its shape, or make your own.
Who had it, why it mattered, and what made it hard.
Your part in it: the decisions you made, the people you worked with, and what you tried that did not work.
The result, in numbers if you have them and in words if you do not. Add pictures with the + between blocks.
